value.rationale: The natural macroscopic linearized response of an expanding circle map exhibits a sharp arithmetic boundary: most spatial forcing harmonics are invisible to long-time cosine feedback and remain uniformly linearly contracting regardless of finite coupling, whereas exact powers of the expansion degree generate a finite cyclic feedback eigensystem with explicitly computable instability thresholds. This all-integer classification explains a structural information-transfer mechanism not quantified by general weak-coupling existence theorems. It is a complete theorem across d,k,epsilon, not a routine numeric sample or arbitrary slice. The conclusion is carefully limited to the linear-response C^1 spectrum.
